sql:
SELECT fished_date_doy, boat, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season=2 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 170 AND 182 AND cls='THREE_QUARTER'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT fish_date_doy, boat, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 170 AND 182 AND cls='three_quarter'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
